en: Around January 6th comes Shahan, Minor cold.
zh: 大約在一月六日是小寒節氣。
ja: 1月6日頃に小寒（シャハン）が訪れます。
local: Around January 6th comes Shahan, Minor cold.
native: Around January 6th comes Shahan, Minor cold.

en: Despite its name, this is often the coldest time of the year.
zh: 儘管名字是小寒，這通常是一年中最冷的時候。
ja: 名前に反して、これは一年で最も寒い時期であることが多いです。
local: Despite its name, this is often the coldest time of the year.
native: Despite its name, this is often the coldest time of the year.

ja: 息が白い霧になります。

en: Children start counting the nine nines of winter.
zh: 孩子們開始數冬天的九九。
ja: 子供たちは冬の九九を数え始めます。
local: Children start counting the nine nines of winter.
native: Children start counting the nine nines of winter.

en: From the winter solstice, they count 81 days in nine groups of nine.
zh: 從冬至開始，他們將81天分成九個九天來計數。
ja: 冬至から81日間を9つの9日間のグループに分けて数えます。
local: From the winter solstice, they count 81 days in nine groups of nine.
native: From the winter solstice, they count 81 days in nine groups of nine.

en: By the time they finish counting, spring will arrive.
zh: 當他們數完時，春天就會到來。
ja: 数え終わる頃には春が訪れます。
local: By the time they finish counting, spring will arrive.
native: By the time they finish counting, spring will arrive.

en: People eat warm lamb soup and spicy hot pot.
zh: 人們吃溫暖的羊肉湯和辣火鍋。
ja: 人々は温かいラムスープと辛い火鍋を食べます。
local: People eat warm lamb soup and spicy hot pot.
native: People eat warm lamb soup and spicy hot pot.

en: The coldest winter makes us appreciate warmth the most.
zh: 最寒冷的冬天讓我們最珍惜溫暖。
ja: 最も寒い冬は私たちに温かさのありがたみを教えてくれます。
local: The coldest winter makes us appreciate warmth the most.
native: The coldest winter makes us appreciate warmth the most.
